paite: Saul kum sawmthum ahih in vaihawm apan a; Israelte tung ah kum nih vai ahawm in,
heading: Philistiate Toh Kidouna

paite: Saul in Israelte lak ah mi sangthum atel hi. Huai teng lak a sangnih Mikmash ah leh Bethel tang ah Saul kiang ah a-om uh. Sangkhat Benjamin gam a Gibeah ah Jonathan kiang ah a-om uh. Adang teng apuanin uah apaisak vek hi.
Jonathan in Gibeah a om Philistia galvil sepaihte ava sual hi. Huai Philistia mite'n ana za uhi. Huchi in Saul in, "Hebru mite'n na za uhen," chi in agam tengteng ah pengkul amutsak hi.
Israel tengteng in, Saul in Philistia galvil sepaihte asual chih leh Israelte'n leng Philistia mite huat in a-om uh chih thute ana zata uh. Huchi in mite Saul kiang ah Gilgal ah akikaikhawm uhi.

Philistia mite Israelte sual ding in akikaikhawm uhi. Kangtalai singthum, sakol tungtuangmi sangguk, mihing tuipi piau a piaunel zah mahmah a tam ahi uh. Huchi in akuantou ua, Beth-aven suahlam pang ah Mikmash ah panmun akhoh uhi.
Israel mite'n umbit in a-om uh chih akitheih un, mite lah alunghimoh mahmahta ua, mite kokhuk ah, lounok ah, suangpi pang ah, kulh ah leikohawm ah akibu uhi.
Hebru mi khenkhatte Jordan gal ah Gad leh Gilead gam ah atai uhi. Saul bel Gilgal ah a-om lailai a, mite'n ling kawmkawm in amah azui uhi.
Samuel hun seh bang in ni sagih ataam hi. Himahleh Samuel lah Gilgal ah ahong pai kei hi. Huchi in mite'n ataizaksanta uh.
Saul in, "Haltum thillat ding leh lemna thillat dingte hiai ah ka kiang ah hon la un," achi hi. Huchi in halmang thillat alan hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, halmang thillat alan khin lel a, ngai in, Samuel ahong tung hi. Amah mu ding in Saul akuan hi. Samuel in, "Bang na hih na hia?" achi hi.
Saul in, "Mite'n ahon paimangsan khin ua, nang lah niseh ni in na hong tungta kei hi. Philistia mite lah Mikmash ah akikaikhawm uh chih ka thei hi.
Huaiziak in 'Philistia mite'n Gilgal ah hon sual dekdek uhi. TOUPA hehpihna lah ka ngen nai kei a,' ka chi hi. Huaiziak in halmang thillat lan lou thei ka hi kei,” achi hi.
Samuel in Saul kiang ah, "Na thilhih ahaihuai mahmah hi. TOUPA na Pathian thupiak, nang thu ahon piak na zui kei hi. TOUPA'N Israelte tung ah na lalna tangtawn a hihkip tum zaw hiven maw,
Himahleh na lalna amongta ding; TOUPA'N thu ahon piak na zuih louh ziak in TOUPA'N ama lungtang bang pumi azong a, mite tung a heutu ding in TOUPA'N amah asepta hi," achi hi.
Samuel athou a, Gilgal a pan Benjamin gam a Gibeah ah ahohtou hi. Saul in akiang a mi omte asim a, zaguk tak ahi uh.
heading: Galdou Ding A Kisakkholhna

paite: Saul leh atapa Jonathan leh akiang ua mi omte Benjamin gam a Gibeah ah a-om uh. Himahleh Philistia mite'n Mikmash ah panmun akhoh uhi.
Lok mite Philistia mite panmun a pan pawl thum ahong kuan ua, pawl khat in Shual gam a Ophrah lam zuan lampi azui uhi.
Pawl khat in Beth-horon lam zuan lampi azui ua, pawl dang in gamdai zul Zeboim Phaizang lam zuan gamgi lampi azui uhi.
Philistia mite'n, "Hebru mite'n namsau hiam, tei hiam abawl kha zenzen ding uh," achih ziak un Israel gam pumpi ah siksekmi akimu kei hi.
Himahleh Israel mi tengteng, michih aleilehna, asuanggal, aheipi, atupi tat-hiam ding in, Philistiate kiang ah ahohsuk zel uhi.
Himahleh tupite, suanggalte, sikkhutte leh heipite tat-hiamna ding sik-hat leh chiang mukzumte bawlna ding anei uhi.
Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, akidou ni un Saul leh Jonathan kiang a om mite'n namsau hiam, tei hiam anei kei uh. Saul leh atapa Jonathan in bel anei uhi.
Philistia galvil sepaihte Mikmash kuam ah apaikheta uhi.
